import io, os
from unittest.mock import patch
from dotenv import load_dotenv, dotenv_values
from dotenv.main import DotEnv

# override=True replaces
with patch.dict(os.environ, {"SAMPLE": "old"}, clear=True):
    ok = load_dotenv(stream=io.StringIO("SAMPLE=new"), override=True)
    print("override=True ->", ok, os.environ.get("SAMPLE"))

# override=False keeps
with patch.dict(os.environ, {"SAMPLE": "old"}, clear=True):
    ok = load_dotenv(stream=io.StringIO("SAMPLE=new"), override=False)
    print("override=False ->", ok, os.environ.get("SAMPLE"))

# absent key, override=False sets it
with patch.dict(os.environ, {}, clear=True):
    ok = load_dotenv(stream=io.StringIO("FRESH=val"), override=False)
    print("override=False absent ->", ok, os.environ.get("FRESH"))

# non-string / None value not written
with patch.dict(os.environ, {}, clear=True):
    d = DotEnv(None, stream=io.StringIO("EMPTY\nX=1"), override=True)
    print("dict ->", dict(d.dict()), "set ->", d.set_as_environment_variables(), "EMPTY in env:", "EMPTY" in os.environ)
EOF
